description: Plan 9.7 (X5.2) acceptance. A cube balanced on one edge (project block InvertedPendulumBody: J = 4e-3 kg m^2 about the edge, m = 0.6 kg, l = 0.085 m, start theta = 0.05 rad) with a reaction wheel (stdlib drives/ReactionWheel: k = 0.0335, R = 1 Ohm, L = 0.1 mH, J_w = 6e-4 kg m^2, housing on the cube) and a 2 ms discrete LQR on [theta, theta', w_rel] (library/LQR.jl, voltage clamp +-12 V) with the gains from design/design.py (Q = diag(2500, 25, 0.01), R = 1/144; K = [-446.597400, -43.875365, -0.762835] for u = -K x, discrete closed-loop poles 0.3762, 0.9802, 0.9967). The reference numbers are design.py's independent integration of the non-linear plant (Radau, with sin(theta) and the winding inductance) under the same sampled-and-held law and clamp; the model run reproduces them to better than 1e-5 rad. The first sample of the controller is at t = Ts (the declared 0 V output is held before it), and the voltage clamp is active for the first three samples only (the initial tilt asks for 22 V).

checks.note: the cube starts 0.05 rad (2.9 deg) off upright
the plan's acceptance: |theta| < 0.2 deg (0.0034907 rad) for t >= 2 s (measured 0.0223 deg)
design.py: 3.8929e-4 rad (0.0223 deg) over [2, 4] s, 9x under the 0.2 deg limit
settle behaviour: the cube is inside 0.2 deg from t = 0.654 s on, well before the 2 s of the plan
the tilt never grows beyond the initial 0.05 rad (peak 0.050014 rad: the 0 V first sample lets gravity add 14 urad)
design.py 0.014607 rad: the saturated first samples have pulled the tilt from 0.05 to 0.0146 rad
design.py -0.004185 rad: the small overshoot to the other side (min -0.0043 rad near 0.43 s)
design.py -0.002021 rad
design.py -1.44e-5 rad: balanced at the end of the run
the sensor integrates the cube's speed from phi(0) = 0.05 and agrees with the body angle
the angle sensor (an integral of the body speed) and the body's own angle agree for the whole run
the plan's acceptance: |u| <= 12 V
the +-12 V clamp is active at the first samples (the unclamped demand is 22 V)
after the first 0.1 s the voltage stays below 0.1 V (measured 0.082 V): the clamp is a start-up event only
the declared 0 V output is held until the first 2 ms sample
the plan's acceptance: the wheel's absolute speed stays under 300 rad/s (measured 4.2 rad/s)
design.py: peak absolute wheel speed 4.165 rad/s
design.py: peak wheel speed relative to the cube 4.684 rad/s (at t = 0.016 s)
design.py 0.9983 rad/s: the wheel speed bleeds off slowly (closed-loop pole -1.65 1/s)
design.py 0.0071 rad/s: the wheel is nearly stopped at the end of the run
the wheel angle relative to the cube (the 3D wheel_joint binding): design.py integrates the relative speed to 3.0750 rad, about half a turn
no solver failure, no causal conflict, no derivative-causal store (W201), no algebraic loop and no event-limit stop; the run reports no diagnostics at all
